title: Supply and Installation of ESE Lightning Arrestor for 13 Lighthouses and Deep Bhavan under Mumbai Directorate.
summary: Supply and installation of ESE (early streamer emission) lightning arrestors at 13 lighthouses and Deep Bhavan under the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Mumbai.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, M. G. Road, Ghatkopar (East), Mumbai

scope.item: Supply and Installation of ESE Lightning Arrestor for 13 Lighthouses and Deep Bhavan (locations as per Annexure-VI, not included in this notice)

money.notes: Estimated cost inclusive of GST. EMD by Demand Draft/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Mumbai, valid three months from technical bid opening; originals by registered/speed post or in person by 13/08/2026 17:00. Firms registered with MSME, NSIC etc. also required to submit EMD.

period.bid_validity: 180 days from the date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Reputed contractors/firms of appropriate category registered with CPWD, State PWD, MES, Railways, BSNL or other Central/State Government/public sector organisations
Eligibility criteria as defined in clause 3.1 of tender document (not included in this notice)
Bidders with near relatives posted as accountant or Gazetted Officer in DGLL not permitted
specs: ESE (Early Streamer Emission) type lightning arrestor
notes: Listing file is named NIQ but document is a Notice Inviting e-Tender (Hindi pages 1-3, English pages 4-5). The 13 lighthouses are listed only in Annexure-VI, which is not part of this document, so individual stations are not recorded. Bid submission 23/07/2026 15:00 to 13/08/2026 15:00; pre-bid meeting at Deep Bhavan, Mumbai.
